The [[Naboo Royal Navy]] possessed a '''base''' next to a [[Water/Legends|river]] southwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]]. It contained buildings such as a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]], multiple [[Factory/Legends|factories]], [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]], [[Turret/Legends|turrets]], and a [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[invasion of Spinnaker]], the [[Navy/Legends|Navy's]] forces attacked the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], which had occupied a [[Unidentified Naboo village (OOM-9)|village]] near the base. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] overcame the initial forces and targeted the base with [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Droid Starfighters]] and [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], ultimately destroying the entire base.

==Description==
The [[Naboo Royal Navy]] was part of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] and served the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Navy/Legends|Navy's]] base was located southwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] and west of a [[Unidentified Naboo village (OOM-9)|village]], both of which were inhabited by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]]. The base was surrounded by layers of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on each of its sides and had a [[Water/Legends|river]] that flowed from the north to the eastern side of the base. By [[Limb/Legends|foot]], the base was only accessible by a shallow part of the river, which led to a paved path that forked towards Spinnaker and the village.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Royal_Navy_airbase.png|thumb|right|300px|External facilities were constructed outside of the base, such as an airbase (top right).]]
The terrain in the base itself was paved with bricks. The center of the base was occupied by a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], which was equipped with defensive [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]] and [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air missiles]]. In clockwise order, the fortress was surrounded by two [[Barracks/Legends|troop centers]], a [[Power core/Legends|power core]], a [[Research Center]], a [[Mech/Legends|mech]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]], a [[Heavy Weapons Factory]], a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], another power core, a [[command center]], and a [[War Center]].<ref name="GB" />

There were also five [[prefab shelter]]s in the western corner of the base. The northern section of the base included a [[Turret/Legends|turret]] and power core, and its entrance was guarded by two turrets. On the river, there lay a [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] that produced [[Boat/Legends|boats]] for the Navy. The base was tended to by [[PKN-49 worker droid]]s. Later, during the [[invasion of Spinnaker]], the droids constructed additional buildings, including another [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] generator near the base's entrance, and an [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]] and an [[animal nursery]] on the other side of the river.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
[[File:Naboo_Royal_Navy_destroyed.png|thumb|left|300px|The base was destroyed by the Trade Federation.]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], who targeted Spinnaker for its supply of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] that forces of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] arrived near the city, the PKN-49 [[Labor droid/Legends|worker droids]] constructed the additional shield generator and the airbase. The Droid Army, under the command of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]], captured the Naboo village to utilize as a base. This prompted the Naboo Royal Navy and Spinnaker to send [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground forces]] into the village to retake it,<ref name="GB" /> but the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] defeated them and began fortifying their position.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The Navy continued to send [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to unsuccessfully attack the village, including royal [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], boats, and [[NB-1 Royal Bomber]]s from the airbase.<ref name="GB" />

OOM-9 expanded his territory by taking control of the strip of land between the Navy's base and the village, sending six [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Droid Starfighters]] to protect a group of three worker [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that built two turrets around the nova [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] in that area. Next, OOM-9 had a group of ten [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] destroy the naval vessels on the river before attacking [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] troopers and turrets at the entrance of the base. The droids then sent in [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]] to destroy the base's fortress, losing at least one to the fortress's turrets. Once it was destroyed, OOM-9 sent in his fighters and [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] to raze the base completely,<ref name="Prima" /> and they were later victorious in capturing Spinnaker.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Naboo Royal Navy base was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]], published on on [[November 7]], [[2001]],<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]] the same year.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The base appears in the third level of the Trade Federation campaign, titled "Spinnaker's Spoils," and although it is not necessary for the player to destroy the base,<ref name="GB" /> it is recommended by the strategy guide.<ref name="Prima" />

The strategy guide states that the base is equipped with anti-aircraft turrets, multiple fortresses, and a spaceport,<ref name="Prima" /> but in the game, there is only one fortress and none of the other building types. If given time, the Naboo Royal Navy's CPU may generate units from the base's initial military buildings to attack the player, such as infantry and pummels, and it will also create [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] from the airbase, which is always constructed after the player starts the level. The worker droids may also construct additional buildings outside of the base's initial boundaries. In the game's easy difficulty mode, the base starts out with two shield generators. In moderate and hard difficulty, the base's worker droids build the additional generator as soon as the level starts.<ref name="GB" /> This article follows the hard difficulty mode's version of events.
